name: calc_sum_card_fixed_points_perm
statement: (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) : ∑ σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin n), (Finset.univ.filter (fun i => σ i = i)).card = n.factorial
closed: ∀ (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n), ∑ σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin n), (Finset.univ.filter (fun i => σ i = i)).card = n.factorial
informal: Total number of fixed points over all permutations of Fin n (n ≥ 1) is n! (expected number of fixed points is 1) — double count pairs (σ,i) with σ i = i: each i has (n−1)! stabiliser elements (MulAction.card stabilizer / Equiv.Perm.decomposeFin), so total n·(n−1)!.
type: ∀ (n : ℕ), 0 < n → ∑ σ, {i | σ i = i}.card = n.factorial
